import { ArmorType, Class, Race, RangedWeaponType, Spec, WeaponType } from '@generated/proto/common';

export type EligibleWeaponType = {
	weaponType: WeaponType;
	canUseTwoHand: boolean;
};

export const CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES: Record<number, ArmorType[]> = {
	[Class.ClassPaladin]: [ArmorType.ArmorTypePlate, ArmorType.ArmorTypeMail, ArmorType.ArmorTypeLeather, ArmorType.ArmorTypeCloth],
	[Class.ClassWarrior]: [ArmorType.ArmorTypePlate, ArmorType.ArmorTypeMail, ArmorType.ArmorTypeLeather, ArmorType.ArmorTypeCloth],
	[Class.ClassMage]: [ArmorType.ArmorTypeCloth],
};

export const CLASS_WEAPON_TYPES: Record<number, EligibleWeaponType[]> = {
	[Class.ClassPaladin]: [{ weaponType: WeaponType.WeaponTypeSword, canUseTwoHand: true }],
	[Class.ClassWarrior]: [{ weaponType: WeaponType.WeaponTypeSword, canUseTwoHand: true }],
	[Class.ClassMage]: [{ weaponType: WeaponType.WeaponTypeStaff, canUseTwoHand: true }],
};

export const CLASS_RANGED_WEAPON_TYPES: Record<number, RangedWeaponType[]> = {
	[Class.ClassPaladin]: [RangedWeaponType.RangedWeaponTypeLibram],
	[Class.ClassWarrior]: [RangedWeaponType.RangedWeaponTypeBow],
	[Class.ClassMage]: [RangedWeaponType.RangedWeaponTypeWand],
};

export const CLASS_RACES: Record<number, Race[]> = {
	[Class.ClassPaladin]: [Race.RaceHuman, Race.RaceDwarf, Race.RaceUndead],
	[Class.ClassWarrior]: [Race.RaceHuman, Race.RaceOrc],
	[Class.ClassMage]: [Race.RaceHuman, Race.RaceGnome],
};

export const SPEC_CAN_DUAL_WIELD = new Set<Spec>([
	Spec.SpecDpsWarrior,
	Spec.SpecProtectionWarrior,
]);
